pages.text: A Clan cat's name grows with them. $(br2)A kit is born with a name ending in -kit. At six moons they become an apprentice and their name ends in -paw. When their mentor judges them ready, they earn a warrior name of their own.
pages.title: Names

pages.text: When a warrior becomes leader, StarClan gives them nine lives and their name ends in -star. $(br2)Choose your own name with care, young one. It will be spoken at Gatherings for many moons.
